token_orders_tier_snapshot.name: token_orders_tier_snapshot

token_orders_gift_fields.name: token_orders_gift_fields

token_orders_gift_binding_order.name: token_orders_gift_binding_order
token_orders_gift_binding_order.value: recipient_bound_at IS NULL OR recipient_bound_at >= created_at

token_orders_settlement_order.name: token_orders_settlement_order
token_orders_settlement_order.value: settled_at IS NULL OR settled_at >= created_at

token_orders_native_verification_order.name: token_orders_native_verification_order

payment_attempts_integrations_present.name: payment_attempts_integrations_present
payment_attempts_integrations_present.value: cardinality(allowed_integration_ids) > 0 AND array_position(allowed_integration_ids, NULL) IS NULL

payment_attempts_confirmation_order.name: payment_attempts_confirmation_order
payment_attempts_confirmation_order.value: confirmed_unpaid_at IS NULL OR confirmed_unpaid_at >= created_at

payment_attempts_expiry_order.name: payment_attempts_expiry_order
payment_attempts_expiry_order.value: provider_expires_at IS NULL OR provider_expires_at > created_at

payment_events_processed_payment_outcome.name: payment_events_processed_payment_outcome

payment_events_purchased_item.name: payment_events_purchased_item
payment_events_purchased_item.value: observed_native_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'purchased' OR (observed_native_product_id IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(observed_native_product_id)) > 0 AND observed_native_units IS NOT NULL AND observed_native_units > 0)

payment_events_native_observation.name: payment_events_native_observation
payment_events_native_observation.value: CASE WHEN verification_method IN ('apple_store_jws', 'google_play_api') THEN native_purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND observed_native_state IS NOT NULL ELSE observed_native_state IS NULL AND observed_native_product_id IS NULL AND observed_native_units IS NULL END

payment_events_inquiry_attempt.name: payment_events_inquiry_attempt
payment_events_inquiry_attempt.value: verification_method <> 'authenticated_inquiry' OR attempt_id IS NOT NULL

payment_events_notification_type.name: payment_events_notification_type
payment_events_notification_type.value: CASE WHEN verification_method IN ('hmac_callback', 'apple_store_notification', 'google_play_rtdn') THEN notification_type IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(notification_type)) > 0 ELSE notification_type IS NULL END

payment_events_native_fields.name: payment_events_native_fields
payment_events_native_fields.value: provider = 'paymob' OR (attempt_id IS NULL AND transaction_id IS NULL AND observed_payment_outcome IS NULL AND NOT confirms_closed_unpaid)

payment_events_paymob_fields.name: payment_events_paymob_fields
payment_events_paymob_fields.value: provider <> 'paymob' OR (native_purchase_id IS NULL AND native_notification_id IS NULL AND observed_native_state IS NULL AND observed_native_product_id IS NULL AND observed_native_units IS NULL)

payment_events_provider_method.name: payment_events_provider_method
payment_events_provider_method.value: CASE provider WHEN 'paymob' THEN verification_method IN ('hmac_callback', 'authenticated_inquiry') WHEN 'apple_app_store' THEN verification_method IN ('apple_store_jws', 'apple_store_notification') WHEN 'google_play' THEN verification_method IN ('google_play_api', 'google_play_rtdn') ELSE false END

payment_events_processing_order.name: payment_events_processing_order
payment_events_processing_order.value: processed_at IS NULL OR processed_at >= verified_at

payment_events_transaction_attempt.name: payment_events_transaction_attempt
payment_events_transaction_attempt.value: transaction_id IS NULL OR attempt_id IS NOT NULL

payment_events_processed_callback_mappin.name: payment_events_processed_callback_mapping
payment_events_processed_callback_mappin.value: verification_method <> 'hmac_callback' OR state <> 'processed' OR transaction_id IS NOT NULL

payment_events_closure_shape.name: payment_events_closure_shape
payment_events_closure_shape.value: NOT confirms_closed_unpaid OR (verification_method = 'authenticated_inquiry' AND transaction_id IS NULL)

payment_events_no_self_origin.name: payment_events_no_self_origin
payment_events_no_self_origin.value: origin_event_id IS NULL OR origin_event_id <> id

payment_events_processed_native_mapping.name: payment_events_processed_native_mapping
payment_events_processed_native_mapping.value: state <> 'processed' OR verification_method NOT IN ('apple_store_notification', 'google_play_rtdn') OR native_purchase_id IS NOT NULL

payment_reconciliation_cases_evidence_pr.name: payment_reconciliation_cases_evidence_present
payment_reconciliation_cases_evidence_pr.value: order_id IS NOT NULL OR attempt_id IS NOT NULL OR transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR payment_event_id IS NOT NULL OR native_purchase_id IS NOT NULL

payment_reconciliation_cases_time_order.name: payment_reconciliation_cases_time_order
payment_reconciliation_cases_time_order.value: resolved_at IS NULL OR resolved_at >= opened_at

payment_transactions_amount_bounds.name: payment_transactions_amount_bounds
payment_transactions_amount_bounds.value: amount_minor > 0 AND captured_minor BETWEEN 0 AND amount_minor AND refunded_minor BETWEEN 0 AND captured_minor

payment_transactions_verification_order.name: payment_transactions_verification_order
payment_transactions_verification_order.value: last_verified_at IS NULL OR last_verified_at >= created_at

payment_transactions_action_parent.name: payment_transactions_action_parent
payment_transactions_action_parent.value: transaction_kind = 'payment' OR parent_transaction_id IS NOT NULL

payment_transactions_no_self_parent.name: payment_transactions_no_self_parent
payment_transactions_no_self_parent.value: parent_transaction_id IS NULL OR parent_transaction_id <> id

store_purchases_namespace.name: store_purchases_namespace
store_purchases_namespace.value: provider IN ('apple_app_store', 'google_play') AND length(btrim(application_id)) > 0 AND (provider_product_id IS NULL OR length(btrim(provider_product_id)) > 0)

store_purchases_provider_identity.name: store_purchases_provider_identity
store_purchases_provider_identity.value: (provider = 'apple_app_store' AND store_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(store_transaction_id)) > 0 AND purchase_token_hash IS NULL AND purchase_token_ciphertext IS NULL AND encryption_key_version IS NULL) OR (provider = 'google_play' AND store_transaction_id IS NULL AND purchase_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(purchase_token_hash) = 32 AND purchase_token_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND encryption_key_version IS NOT NULL AND encryption_key_version > 0)

store_purchases_mapping_pair.name: store_purchases_mapping_pair
store_purchases_mapping_pair.value: ((store_product_id IS NULL) = (product_token_quantity IS NULL)) AND (store_product_id IS NULL OR provider_product_id IS NOT NULL)

store_purchases_quantity_presence.name: store_purchases_quantity_presence
store_purchases_quantity_presence.value: (verified_token_quantity IS NULL) = (product_token_quantity IS NULL OR purchased_units IS NULL)

store_purchases_exact_quantity.name: store_purchases_exact_quantity
store_purchases_exact_quantity.value: verified_token_quantity IS NULL OR (verified_token_quantity > 0 AND verified_token_quantity::numeric = product_token_quantity::numeric * purchased_units)

store_purchases_order_buyer.name: store_purchases_order_buyer
store_purchases_order_buyer.value: intended_order_id IS NULL OR buyer_account_id IS NOT NULL

store_purchases_attribution_order.name: store_purchases_attribution_order
store_purchases_attribution_order.value: attributed_at IS NULL OR attributed_at >= created_at

store_purchases_verification_order.name: store_purchases_verification_order
store_purchases_verification_order.value: last_verified_at IS NULL OR last_verified_at >= created_at

store_purchases_verified_price_presence.name: store_purchases_verified_price_presence
store_purchases_verified_price_presence.value: price_amount IS NULL OR (price_amount >= 0 AND price_currency IS NOT NULL)

store_purchases_completion_order.name: store_purchases_completion_order
store_purchases_completion_order.value: completion_requested_at IS NULL OR completion_requested_at >= created_at

store_purchases_completion_shape.name: store_purchases_completion_shape
store_purchases_completion_shape.value: (completion_state = 'not_required' AND completion_requested_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (completion_state = 'pending' AND completion_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (completion_state = 'completed' AND completion_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= completion_requested_at)

staff_sessions_revocation_order.name: staff_sessions_revocation_order
staff_sessions_revocation_order.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at

contact_submissions_rating_bounds.name: contact_submissions_rating_bounds
contact_submissions_rating_bounds.value: rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5

contact_submissions_form_shape.name: contact_submissions_form_shape
contact_submissions_form_shape.value: (kind = 'support' AND support_reason IS NOT NULL AND support_reason IN ('technical', 'purchase', 'account') AND business_kind IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL AND message IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(message)) >= 5 AND rating IS NULL) OR (kind = 'business' AND business_kind IS NOT NULL AND business_kind IN ('business', 'influencer') AND support_reason IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL AND message IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(message)) >= 5 AND rating IS NULL) OR (kind = 'experience' AND support_reason IS NULL AND business_kind IS NULL AND (rating IS NOT NULL OR (message IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(message)) > 0)))

contact_submissions_closing_order.name: contact_submissions_closing_order
contact_submissions_closing_order.value: closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= created_at

outbox_events_attempt_bounds.name: outbox_events_attempt_bounds
outbox_events_attempt_bounds.value: max_attempts > 0 AND attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND max_attempts

outbox_events_finish_order.name: outbox_events_finish_order
outbox_events_finish_order.value: finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= created_at
